name: Wymara Resort, Turks and Caicos
positioning: Sleek, modern sustainable luxury resort of oceanfront Studios and Suites on Grace Bay Beach, Providenciales
best_for: Beach lovers who want an oceanfront Studio or Suite looking over Grace Bay Beach
Wellness-minded travelers who want complimentary beach yoga, breathwork and sound healing
Couples who want a couples massage on the beach

facts.text: Wymara Resort is a sleek, modern sustainable luxury resort on Grace Bay Beach, Providenciales, in Turks and Caicos.
Guests stay in oceanfront Studios or Suites with views of Grace Bay Beach.
The resort has an extensive Penthouse Suite.
Guests can take in the turquoise waters of Grace Bay and relax at the resort's infinity pool.
Complimentary expert-led wellness programs include yoga on Grace Bay Beach, breathwork for restful sleep, sound healing therapy and SUP Aqua yoga.
The Spa offers couples massage on the beach and advanced skin rejuvenation therapy by 111SKIN.
The Spa at Wymara Resort has introduced Hot and Cold Plunge therapy.
Indigo serves Southern Caicos Lobster Tail.
The resort holds Beach Barbecues with a fire pit and live entertainment.
Wymara Resort + Villas was named a winner of the inaugural Conde Nast Traveler Triple Crown.
Wymara Resort + Villas was awarded the Michelin Key 2026.
The local reef is the third largest in the world.

highlights.text: Guests can take in the turquoise waters of Grace Bay while relaxing at the resort's infinity pool.
Oceanfront Studios and Suites have views of Grace Bay Beach.

considerations.text: Guests fly into Providenciales Airport (PLS); the resort is approximately 10 to 14 minutes from the airport.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the luxury experience.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires flight connections.
